jian_wei_lim.name: Jian Wei Lim
jian_wei_lim.private_context: Jian Wei emailed the lease to Margaret on Tuesday morning. He expects her to sign and return it.

margaret_thornbury.name: Margaret Thornbury
margaret_thornbury.private_context: Margaret has signed and returned every document Jian Wei has sent her within a day. She told Jian Wei on Monday that she was ready to sign. She has a printer and scanner at home.
